name: hr_attrition_risk_v1

abstention_rule.description: confidence < 0.75 -> no score returned or stored (business-wide)

training_cadence: manual / explicit via `uv run --directory services/ai-agent ai-agent attrition-train`; the platform has NO scheduler (matches the leave-accrual lazy precedent)
refresh: lazy-on-read TTL in core: scores regenerated when the attrition endpoint is read and the latest generated_at is older than AI_HR_REFRESH_INTERVAL_DAYS (default 7); idempotent per (employee_id, model_version)
known_limitations: default model is fit on a small bundled reference dataset for reproducible out-of-the-box scoring; it is a placeholder until a validated model is trained via the CLI
confidence is a v1 heuristic (magnitude from the abstention edge + activity/compa data presence), not a calibrated probability
feature data quality depends on core exposing compa-ratio baseline and activity counts; sparse data lowers confidence and may abstain
no scheduler: model version only advances when a human retrains and exports via the CLI
